title: Lucky Cat
author: Claude
blurb: It is Friday the 13th, and the whole town blames Midnight, the black cat, for every bit of bad luck. So she sets out to prove she is lucky: thirteen lucky charms, a mirror maze that swaps left and right, umbrellas that pop open indoors, a race to the fair before the clock strikes thirteen, and a crow who keeps knocking on wood. A short special that only stops by for a few days.
